card.title: 511th REGIMENT
card.text: Defense of this unit cannot go lower than 1. Becomes Veteran after it takes damage.
card.flavorText: The 511th Rifle Regiment joined the 239th Rifle Division when that formation was converted from a motorized division into a regular rifle division in July 1941. The division was first formed in the Soviet Far East as part of the prewar mechanized buildup, then gave up its tank regiment and many vehicles during reorganization. The 511th became one of its three rifle regiments, alongside the 813th and 817th. The 239th Rifle Division was moved west in November 1941 as the German advance threatened Moscow. It arrived in Tula Oblast and was thrown into battle almost entirely against elements of the 2nd Panzer Army. The division was later encircled near Stalinogorsk, broke out, and joined the Soviet winter counteroffensive. In 1942 it fought in the costly Battle of Rzhev, then moved north to the Volkhov Front. There, it took part in operations to break the siege of Leningrad and helped drive German forces away from the city in 1944, earning the Order of the Red Banner. The 511th Regiment later received the Orders of Alexander Nevsky and Kutuzov for its actions in Latvia and Silesia.
